title: tunnel_auth: revoked re-post returns Revoked instead of Replay
description: cargo test -p lichen-gateway --lib tunnel_auth::tests::revocation_root_change_expiry_and_lru_fail_closed fails deterministically at lichen-gateway/src/tunnel_auth.rs:954: after table.revoke(...), re-accepting the same root post asserts Err(TunnelAuthError::Replay) but accept_post returns Err(TunnelAuthError::Revoked). Pre-existing failure in committed code (tunnel_auth.rs last modified in 660b9bf3bf, no working-tree changes). Discovered while verifying bead project-LICHEN-worker6-5a5h; out of that bead's scope. Either the revocation check should report Replay for an already-seen post (ordering), or the test expectation needs updating after design review — do not weaken the test to pass; fix the check ordering or document the intended precedence.
